headline: The clap witness gets a quiet box: nightly line-3 evidence on CI
lede: Line 3 of PLAICRAFT S1 — "audio lines up with the frames to within ±50 ms" — needed a strict --witness run, and this Mac has never been quiet enough for one all week. PR #2730 moved the witness stand to a hosted runner: a nightly advisory job that runs the strict clap gate where contention can't reach it, stamped YES at −32.5 ms on its very first pass.

notes.text: #2730 merged 36f57d6 — plaicraft-witness-nightly.yml (cron 07:15 UTC): strict plaicraft:clap -- --witness on GitHub's ubuntu runner, advisory in every direction (#1358 law), no secrets. First CI proof rode the PR itself: 15/15, line-3 machine evidence YES, worst −32.5 ms at a quiet 43 fps.

The contended box still tells the truth when it's loud: this Mac's strict witness went RED naming its starvation (14 fps, clock trace frozen, drift −1077 ms) while the aim pipeline visibly worked (pair 2 landed at 11 ms). Reds that name themselves are evidence, not noise (#2654).

A new nightly cannot dispatch itself — GitHub 404s workflow_dispatch for workflows absent from main. Rule 5a's first CI pass must be engineered in: a paths-limited pull_request trigger rides the proof on its own PR.

#1711's remaining blocker is one human clap: Jon's phone take (jonq #2652, deadline Nov 20). Machine halves of all four lines now hold — consent mutants pinned, 14/14 replay PASS, 3/3 phone takes, and line 3 witnesses nightly.
